Title: Important Text
Scenario body: You feel your heart racing as you write a long text to a friend about something important to you. After a few hours go by, they still haven’t responded. You think their lack of response means they are busy.

Photo name: You freeze during a math test and can't remember a formula you studied last night. Your heart begins to race in your chest, and you wonder if you're too jittery to finish the test. You tell yourself that it's ______ to be a little anxious during a test. normal

You are running a few minutes late to class, and you race up the main staircase. As you are running, you trip and fall in an awkward way, and your face turns red as you feel a rush of humiliation. The other people in the hallway are probably wondering if you are okay.
